_doc: Sound effects generated with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (see generate.py). name: the game's sound id (src/audio.js synth names); n: variants; dur: requested seconds. set: a faction sound set (assets/sfx/<set>/, loaded only when that faction fights); like: [synth name, pitch], the synthesised sound it falls back to. floor: the lowest loudness level calibrate.cjs may give it (signature moves whose synth stand-in is quiet).
style: Clean, punchy, close-miked video game sound effect, no music, no voices, no background noise, single isolated sound.
